INSULATED JUMPERS · solder only named endpoints
Filled colored endpoints are solder joints. White gaps at
crossings indicate insulation. A line passing a hole does
not join that hole. The numbered checklist defines every
Identify actual transistor E/B/C or D/G/S roles first.
Package outlines are schematic, not a flat-face pin-order
instruction. Sleeve crossed leads and all jumper spans.
Only named wire endpoints join. Blank-board pads are separate. OUT− is system ground; BAT− stays separate.
